subject: Dedicated capacity allocation - HelixBridge (Urgent request)
messages:
From: Santiago Gomez <santiago@helixbridge.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: HelixBridge Ops <ops@helixbridge.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent - Dedicated GPU allocation for HelixBridge annual training

Jasmine,

We’re in a tough spot on our end — the customer annual training window moved up by two weeks and our execs are asking for guaranteed dedicated GPU capacity for a 72-hour window beginning July 6. We previously discussed a 4xA100 reserved commitment under HB-2026-042, but the additional transient load requires an extra 8 GPUs for the training jobs. Can Redwood commit those as reserved or guaranteed burst?

We understand this is outside the original SOW, but given the timeline we need a quick yes/no so we can mobilize our internal engineers.

Attaching a short schedule and expected token volume for the job.

—Santiago
HelixBridge, Head of Infrastructure
Attachments: helixbridge_training_schedule.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Santiago Gomez <santiago@helixbridge.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent - Dedicated GPU allocation for HelixBridge annual training

Hi Santiago — thanks for the heads up and the schedule. I’m pulling in the allocation leads so we can assess impact and provide a clear response by EOD tomorrow.

Vivek/Ben/Neha — quick context: HelixBridge (deal HB-2026-042) is asking for +8 GPUs as reserved/burst for July 6–8 training. They’re asking for guaranteed capacity; our current committed pool has limited headroom. I’m attaching a proposed allocation_scorecard which shows current reservations, headroom, and a draft scoring rubric for prioritization. Please review and reply with your recommended path (reserve vs burst vs partial preemption) + any contract changes needed.

Attachments: allocation_scorecard_v1.xlsx (attachment stub)

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jun 2028 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent - Dedicated GPU allocation for HelixBridge annual training

Jasmine — I reviewed the scorecard. Quick take: HelixBridge is high-revenue but medium-latency sensitivity for inference; this is a training event (batch) which we can schedule into low-latency capacity windows if we accept longer job tails. Policies: our reserved pool cannot be fully reallocated without an SLA/contract amendment. Policy excerpt below (see attachment).

Proposal: Offer a mixed approach — 4 GPUs as short-term reserved (contract amendment + pro-rated charge) and 4 GPUs as burst capacity on our dedicated bursting lanes with a soft-preempt clause. This keeps our top-tier latency customers protected while helping HelixBridge complete training on schedule.

Questions: do we have legal ok to pro-rate reserved changes on a one-week notice? If not, burst-only with discounted burst rates may be simpler.

Attachment: capacity_policy_excerpt.pdf (attachment stub)

—Vivek

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent - Dedicated GPU allocation for HelixBridge annual training

Agree with Vivek’s middle path. Operationally, we can carve 4 GPUs out of a near-term reserved tranche if the customer signs a short amendment; it’s an administrative headache but doable. For the other 4 GPUs, we have a burst lane used by two smaller customers that are both flexible — we can temporarily throttle them and route HelixBridge jobs there with preemption.

Operational notes:
- Need ENG ticket to patch KV-cache pinning for HelixBridge job to avoid cold-starts when moved to burst lanes (JIRA INF-4527).
- Need to update SOW pricing and bill pro-rata for reserved tranche.

If legal can fast-track amendment, I’m supportive. If not, we propose burst-only (discounted) and offer a credits package if preemption occurs.

—Ben

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jun 2028 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent - Dedicated GPU allocation for HelixBridge annual training

Team — legal confirmed we can amend the reserved commitment with a one-off pro-rated charge; finance will invoice retroactively. I attached a short SOW delta. If we proceed with 4x reserved + 4x burst: we should require an uptick clause (minimum 30% additional notice for future training) and an indemnity on job misconfiguration during burst.

I’ve attached the updated SOW (deal_sow_v2.pdf). Jasmine, I’ll need you to confirm commercial terms with HelixBridge so I can get signatures and process the amendment.

Attachment: deal_sow_v2.pdf (attachment stub)

—Neha

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Santiago Gomez <santiago@helixbridge.ai>
Cc: HelixBridge Ops <ops@helixbridge.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: Allocation decision for July training window (HB-2026-042)

Santiago — update from our side and next steps. Internal committee recommends the following:

1) We will commit 4 GPUs as a short-term reserved tranche for HelixBridge July 6–8. This requires a one-off amendment to HB-2026-042 (pro-rated charge).
2) We will provide an additional 4 GPUs as burst capacity on our dedicated bursting lanes with a soft-preemption clause (priority scoring will avoid preemption unless capacity is critically constrained).
3) Operational actions: JIRA INF-4527 created for KV-cache pinning change; our infra team will provision and run a warmup 24 hours before the window.

Next steps for HelixBridge: please confirm acceptance of the SOW delta (attached) and confirm the primary contact for provisioning. Once we have a signed amendment, Finance will invoice the pro-rated reserve charge and we’ll schedule the infra work.

Attachments: deal_sow_v2.pdf (attachment stub)

Thanks for working with us to get this scheduled. I’ll loop back once provisioned.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
